app.name: Electricity price
app.summary: The electricity price now, with a graph of today and tomorrow, from a Nord Pool, ENTSO-e or GE-Spot sensor.
app.tile_example: The price now and the day's graph
app.unit_hint: Show the price in euros per kWh (0.273) or in cents per kWh (27.3).
app.decimals_hint: How many decimals the price shows. In cents one is enough.
app.extra_hint: Your delivery price per kWh is (p + a) × b + c, with p the sensor's price per kWh in its own currency, also when you show cents. Put the energy tax and your supplier's surcharge in a.
app.factor_hint: The factor: 1.21 adds 21% VAT. 0 leaves only c, a fixed price.
app.plus_hint: Added after the factor. For a fixed price: b 0 and c your price per kWh.
app.feed_in_hint: Also show what a kWh you feed back brings. Each bar then runs from the feed-in price up to the delivery price.
app.feed_extra_hint: Your feed-in price per kWh is (p + a) × b + c, as for delivery. Your supplier's deduction is a negative a.
app.feed_factor_hint: The factor: 1 without VAT. 0 leaves only c, a fixed feed-in price.
app.feed_plus_hint: Added after the factor. For a fixed feed-in price: b 0 and c the price per kWh.
